meta.note: Most modern IOL formulas are proprietary. This config contains formula metadata and reference information.

iol_evo2.name: EVO 2.0
iol_evo2.author: Tiziano Bellini et al.
iol_evo2.description: Uses artificial intelligence and emmetropia verifying optical (EVO) formula. Version 2.0 includes enhanced ML algorithms.

iol_hoffer_qst.name: Hoffer QST
iol_hoffer_qst.author: Kenneth Hoffer, MD & Giacomo Savini, MD
iol_hoffer_qst.description: Optimized Hoffer Q formula using Sum-of-Segments (SS) axial length and Total Keratometry (TK).

iol_kane.name: Kane Formula
iol_kane.author: Jack Kane, MD
iol_kane.description: Combines theoretical optics with artificial intelligence and regression analysis.

iol_pearl_dgs.name: PEARL-DGS
iol_pearl_dgs.author: Debellemanière G, Gatinel D, Saad A
iol_pearl_dgs.description: PhacoEmulsification Assessment Rational Learning. Uses deep learning trained on large dataset.

torica.title: Toric IOL
torica.description: Toric IOL calculations for astigmatism correction

iol_evo_toric.name: EVO Toric
iol_evo_toric.author: Tiziano Bellini et al.
iol_evo_toric.description: Toric adaptation of EVO formula using AI for cylinder power and axis prediction.

iol_hoffer_qst_toric.name: Hoffer QST Toric
iol_hoffer_qst_toric.author: Kenneth Hoffer, MD & Giacomo Savini, MD
iol_hoffer_qst_toric.description: Toric adaptation of Hoffer QST with vector analysis for astigmatism.

iol_kane_toric.name: Kane Toric
iol_kane_toric.author: Jack Kane, MD
iol_kane_toric.description: Toric version combining Kane formula with AI-driven astigmatism correction.

postLVC.title: IOL Post LVC (Post Laser Vision Correction)
postLVC.description: IOL calculations for eyes that have undergone previous refractive surgery (LASIK, PRK, RK)

iol_evo2_post.name: EVO 2.0 Post-LVC
iol_evo2_post.author: Tiziano Bellini et al.
iol_evo2_post.description: EVO 2.0 formula adapted for post-refractive surgery eyes.

iol_pearl_dgs_post.name: PEARL-DGS Post-LVC
iol_pearl_dgs_post.author: Debellemanière G, Gatinel D, Saad A
iol_pearl_dgs_post.description: PEARL-DGS formula adapted for post-refractive surgery eyes.

iol_ray_tracing.name: Ray Tracing
iol_ray_tracing.author: Various (Okulix, Sirius, Pentacam)
iol_ray_tracing.description: Uses actual ray tracing through measured corneal surfaces. Traces light rays from retina through the entire optical system.

AXL.name: Axial Length
AXL.description: Distance from corneal apex to retina

ACD.name: Anterior Chamber Depth
ACD.description: Distance from corneal endothelium to anterior lens surface
